commonLandings.feedback: That counts the hops instead of where they land. Starting at 10, six hops land on 16.
That is one hop short. Count each of the six hops onto 10.

widget.missFeedback: Start at 10 and make 6 hops right, one number at a time.
widget.successFeedback: Six hops on from 10 lands on 16 — a ten and 6 ones.

predict.prompt: You start at 10 and hop forward 6. Where will you land?
